summary: Authored lightweight RFC design document proposing API gateway rate limiting with Redis token bucket.
evidence: Problem statement highlights the 50k req/min incident, 2 AM manual redeployments, and blocked paid tier launch.
Proposed approach specifies gateway-level token bucket algorithm with Redis Lua scripts and standard HTTP 429 headers.
Evaluated two concrete alternatives (in-memory per-pod vs Redis fixed window) with balanced pros and cons.
Detailed risks and mitigations including Redis fail-open strategy, latency co-location, and risk of doing nothing.
Included 2 unresolved open questions on enterprise overrides and unauthenticated endpoint defaults.
